items.request: Elegxe prosektika ta stoicheia tis parakato fantastikis anakoinosis, giati thelo na eimai sigouros oti den tha vgaleis lathos symperasma: an oi theseis pou apomenoun einai pano apo miden, dose ton akrivi arithmo tous kai to kostos symmetochis. Alliws, pes oti i drastiriotita einai pliris. Dose mono tin apantisi pou antistoichei sta stoicheia, oxi kai tis dyo periptoseis.
